{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:ColonelPetigar-TheEye.png]] |name=Soden Petigar |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[5 BBY]], [[Aldhani]]''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Aldhani]] in ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which includes Soden Petigar's [[death]], to [[5 BBY]]. The ''Andor'' episode "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]" states that the [[Galactic Empire]] arrived on the world thirteen [[Standard year|years]] earlier, meaning its arrival took place in [[18 BBY]]. |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Gray]]{{Andor|The Eye}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Officer Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Now, what do you make of him?''"
"''Colonel Petigar? He's an engineer. You won't charm him.''"
"''Well, it won't be for lack of trying.|Jayhold Beehaz and Gorn|audio=WontCharm-Beehaz-Gorn-TheEye.flac|}} [[Colonel]] '''Soden Petigar''' was a [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as an [[engineer]]. He was tasked with developing the next steps of the Imperial occupation of the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]] and traveled there in [[5 BBY]] to visit a [[Aldhani dam|dam]] where the [[Aldhani Garrison]] was based. At the dam, [[Commandant]] [[Jayhold Beehaz]] and [[Lieutenant]] [[Gorn]] discussed the Imperial manipulation of the local [[Dhani]] population with Petigar and assured him they would not be a problem for the planned development. Looking forward to viewing the upcoming [[Eye of Aldhani]] celestial event, Petigar witnessed a [[meteor]] pass over the dam while using a [[survey scope]]. He then accompanied Gorn, Beehaz, and the commandant's [[Jayhold Beehaz's family|family]] to a ceremonial exchange of hides with the natives, which assured the Imperials another three-[[Standard year|year]] lease. Following the exchange, Petigar returned to the dam with Beehaz and his family, where the group was held at [[blaster]] point by a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|group]] of [[Axis network|rebels]] aiming to [[Aldhani heist|steal]] the Imperial [[Currency|payroll]] held in the [[garrison]]. Petigar drew his [[blaster pistol]] and demanded that the rebels release Beehaz's [[Gender|son]], [[Leonart Beehaz]], but the engineer was then shot and [[Death|killed]] by the rebel [[Cinta Kaz]]. ==Biography== ===Architect of Aldhani=== {{Quote|What's with all the patrols on Stone Canyon?''"
"''There's an Imperial engineer arriving from Coruscant. We've been mapping the old trail for him. But that'll stop tomorrow.|Vel Sartha and Gorn|audio=MappingTrail-Vel-Gorn-Aldhani.flac|}} [[File:AldhaniImperialOccupation-TheEye.png|thumb|right|300px|Soden Petigar was tasked with developing the next steps in the Imperial occupation of Aldhani.]] Soden Petigar was a [[human]] [[engineer]] who served as a [[colonel]] in the [[Imperial Officer Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He was tasked with developing the next steps and expansion of the Imperial occupation of the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]], where the Empire had arrived in [[18 BBY]] and liberated the [[Alkenzi Air Base]] before damming up the [[Nasma Klain]] [[Water|river]] and establishing a [[Aldhani Garrison|garrison]] in the [[Aldhani dam|dam]], which acted as a depot for supplies, [[weapon]]s, and the [[Cademimu sector|sector's]] Imperial [[Currency|payroll]]. Over the following thirteen [[Standard year|years]], the Empire relocated the [[Homeworld|native]] [[Dhani]] people who lived in the valleys around the [[garrison]] to work in [[Factory|factories]] in the [[Enterprise Zone]] in the [[Lowlands]] of the world. There was discussion of tearing down the dam and moving the airbase to replace it,{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} with plans made for Petigar to travel from the Imperial [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]] to visit Aldhani in [[5 BBY]]. In preparation for his arrival, the garrison began mapping an old trail for him, resulting in increased patrols in the area known as [[Stone Valley|Stone Canyon]]. [[Lieutenant]] [[Gorn]], a member of the garrison who was secretly working with a [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|infiltration team]] planning to [[Aldhani heist|steal]] the payroll from the garrison, ensured that the patrols ceased two [[Standard day|days]] before the engineer's scheduled arrival and refocused the Imperials' attention on the Lowlands, informing the team's leader, [[Vel Sartha]], about Petigar when she asked about the patrols. [[File:Aldhani_dam_full_view.png|thumb|left|300px|Preparations were made at Aldhani dam for Soden Petigar's arrival.]] Other preparations were made for Petigar's arrival, with Gorn ordering that a gantry inside the dam be painted before the [[engineering officer]] arrived and got involved in their business. When the gantry still had not been painted on the day that the colonel was due to arrive, Gorn threatened to have his subordinates paint it during the upcoming celestial event known as the [[Eye of Aldhani]] but agreed to have it completed after Petigar arrived so that the men could view the event. ===Arrival=== {{Quote|Have they any idea this is the last time they'll be allowed up here?''"
"''No, there's no profit in that. We've spent the last decade promoting an Imperial viewing festival down in the Enterprise Zone. They'll have that going forward.''"
"''It is their sacred valley, is it not?''"
"''Well, ultimately, they will return, won't they, Colonel? When you need plenty of arms and legs to build all you've got planned.|Soden Petigar and Jayhold Beehaz|audio=LastFestival-Beehaz-Petigar-TheEye.flac|}} The morning after his arrival, Petigar met with Gorn and [[Commandant]] [[Jayhold Beehaz]], [[commander]] of the garrison, in an observation tower on the dam.{{Andor|The Eye}} {{AD|Disney+}} Gorn brought the colonel and the commandant a drink as Beehaz explained to Petigar about how the Imperials had manipulated the native Dhani and reduced the number that would attend the Eye of Aldhani event in [[Akti Amaugh]], the valley in which the dam was built. [[File:PetigarBeehaz-TheEye.png|thumb|right|300px|Soden Petigar met with Jayhold Beehaz and Gorn in the Aldhani dam and discussed the native Dhani.]] Petigar asked if the Dhani knew that it would be the final [[time]] they visited the sacred valley, and Beehaz admitted that they were unaware but attempted to reassure Petigar that they had provided a replacement Imperial viewing event in the Enterprise Zone, pointing out that the Dhani would eventually return to the valley as laborers for Petigar's plans. The engineer then asked Gorn, who had served longest at the dam, if he thought that the Dhanis would react violently to the new facility being built. Gorn pointed out the Dhanis would have no choice but to be peaceful, and Beehaz then changed the subject to tell Petigar about how spectacular the Eye was to witness, with the colonel revealing that he was looking forward to the event. ===Observing local customs=== {{Quote|We trade goat hides for a three-year lease. If they didn't smell so badly it might be amusing. Come on, you two. The Dhanis have a rough appetite for fragrance.''"
"''Yes, I've been warned.|Jayhold Beehaz and Soden Petigar as they prepare to leave with Beehaz's family|audio=RoughFragrance-Beehaz-Petigar-TheEye.flac|}} After leaving Petigar to exit the dam, Beehaz, who hoped to impress Petigar so that he and his [[Jayhold Beehaz's family|family]] could be transferred to a more pleasant world, asked Gorn's opinion of the colonel; however, the lieutenant warned the commandant that he would not be able to charm the engineer despite his attempts. Petigar, meanwhile, moved to an alcove in the dam and set up a [[survey scope]], using it to watch the descent of a [[meteor]] over the valley. When Gorn then passed by, the colonel asked him if the meteor signaled that the Eye had begun, but the lieutenant explained that the Dhanis believed that it never ended, and so the event had certainly started. [[File:PeltTrading-TheEye.png|thumb|left|300px|Soden Petigar witnessed Jayhold Beehaz trading goat hides to the Dhani, which secured another three-year lease for the Imperials.]] Petigar then joined Beehaz and his family inside the dam, where Gorn delivered a pile of [[goat]] hides that Beehaz was to present to the Dhanis arriving to watch the Eye. The commandant explained to Petigar that the hides would buy them another three-year lease and warned him that the natives would smell, although the engineer had already been informed. The group then left, with Petigar glancing out of the window and then smelling the goat hides as he passed, which caused him to grimace. The colonel then accompanied Beehaz and his family down to the [[Nasma Brani]] temple in front of the dam to meet the Dhanis, briefly stopping on the way for Beehaz to inspect a group of Imperials that he was told were from Alkenzi, although they were in fact Gorn's rebel allies. At the temple, the [[Unidentified Dhani chieftain|Dhani chieftain]] permitted Petigar and the rest of the entourage to enter, after which the engineer watched the tense exchange of pelts between the Imperials and the natives. ===A valiant effort=== {{Quote|Stop right there. Let the boy go. Let the boy go!|Soden Petigar demands the release of Leonart Beehaz|audio=PetigarFinalWords-TheEye.flac|}} With the ceremony complete, Petigar returned to the dam with Gorn, Beehaz, and the commandant's family, escorted by the group of disguised rebels. As they walked, Beehaz complained to Petigar that it was the older Dhanis that caused all the problems and as they entered the dam, he claimed things would soon be much easier with the days of trading pelts behind them. Once the group were all inside bar Gorn, the rebels locked the doors behind them and raised their weapons, ordering an Imperial sentry present to drop his [[E-10.5 rifle|weapon]]. The sentry complied and the commandant's family dropped to the floor as a shocked Beehaz questioned what was happening. As the rebel [[Karis Nemik]] then moved past Petigar, the engineer pulled out his [[Power 5 blaster|Power 5]] [[blaster pistol]] and aimed it at Nemik, creating a standoff as the other rebels trained their weapons on him. [[File:Petigar-weapon-drawn.png|right|thumb|300px|Soden Petigar died trying to demand that the child Leonart Beehaz be released from blasterpoint.]] The colonel demanded that the rebels release Beehaz's [[Gender|son]], [[Leonart Beehaz]], more loudly reiterating his command when the rebel [[Arvel Skeen]] pushed the muzzle of his [[blaster rifle]] into the back of Leonart's neck. The commandant then pleaded with Petigar to stand down as the rebel [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] tried to assure him that no one need [[Death|die]], but at that moment, the rebel [[Cinta Kaz]], who had infiltrated the facility separately, shot Petigar as she descended into the room. Petigar was killed, firing as he fell and narrowly missing Nemik when the shot went wide. The rebels then left Petigar's corpse where it had fallen as they continued with their plan to [[Thief|steal]] the payroll and hurried Leonart and the other hostages away. Petigar was the first, but far from final Imperial casualty of the heist, which also claimed the lives of the commandant and several other Imperial personnel as well as Gorn, Nemik, and the rebel [[Taramyn Barcona]]. Despite their casualties, the rebels ultimately succeeded in stealing the payroll [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|The Eye, Colonel, you're in for a treat. It really is something to see. Quite the celestial spectacle.''"
"''I'm looking forward to it.|Jayhold Beehaz and Soden Petigar|audio=CelestialSpectacle-Beehaz-Petigar-TheEye.flac|}} Soden Petigar looked forward to witnessing the Eye of Aldhani while on the planet but was concerned that the locals would violently oppose his project there. He smiled when Commandant Beehaz discussed manipulating the Dhanis, though Gorn was confident that the engineer could not be charmed. When held at [[blaster]]point, he risked drawing his own weapon to try and demand the release of the only [[Youngling|child]] present, costing him his life. The colonel had light skin, [[Color|gray]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard]] with an aristocratic accent. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Has it started?''"
"''Well, the Dhanis don't believe it ever ends. So, yes, sir, it has definitely started.|Soden Petigar questions Gorn about the Eye of Aldhani after witnessing a meteor through his survey scope|audio=DefinitelyStarted-Petigar-Gorn-TheEye.flac|}} [[File:PetigarMeteor-TheEye.png|thumb|left|300px|Soden Petigar used a survey scope to observe a meteor on Aldhani.]] Soden Petigar wore a gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with a [[code cylinder]] on each [[breast]] and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with a row of five orange squares denoting his engineering background,{{SW|url=andor-s1-e6-trivia-gallery|text="The Eye" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 2}} and then a red square furthest to his left. When heading outside the dam, he wore an [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]], a dark green [[Jacket|overcoat]], and black [[glove]]s. He made use of a [[Power 5 blaster|Power 5]] blaster [[pistol]] carried in a [[holster]] on his left hip and a survey [[scope]]. ==Behind the scenes== Soden Petigar was created for the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' and was first revealed in the teaser trailer for the show released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|j5UX1Adanis|Andor | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/andor-teaser-trailer}} He was first indirectly mentioned in the show's [[Andor Season 1|first season]] within its fourth episode, "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]," which aired on [[September 28]], 2022.{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} The character then appeared in the sixth episode, "[[The Eye]]," which aired on [[October 12]], 2022. He was portrayed by [[Richard Katz]] in the episode and only identified as Colonel Petigar. Exterior scenes on Aldhani were filmed at the [[Wikipedia:Cruachan Power Station|Cruachan Dam]] and the surrounding mountains in the [[Wikipedia:Scottish Highlands|Scottish Highlands]],{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/gppr5wpqgb4t74974f8s|text=ANDOR Production Brief V3 FINAL 8-04-22|author=[[Gina McIntyre|McIntyre, Gina]]|date=2022-08-04}} with filming taking place during the middle of the [[Wikipedia:COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.slashfilm.com/1082395/andors-faye-marsay-talks-preparing-to-play-vel-sartha-the-real-rebellions-that-inspired-her-more-exclusive-interview|text=Andor's Faye Marsay Talks Preparing To Play Vel Sartha, The Real Rebellions That Inspired Her & More [Exclusive Interview]|author=Anderton, Ethan|date=2022-11-02|archivedate=20221102170524}} The character's first name of Soden was revealed in the [[2023]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'', within a section written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].{{WookYouTube|-nqSqVOvfM4|Wookieepedia Interviews -
